Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a chemical probe (alkyne P29) for activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) via biotin-streptavidin enrichment, which falls under the mod_ap_ms modifier. While the study identifies covalent modification of thioredoxin, the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset' regarding the search parameters, though the methods describe a static modification for iodoacetamide alkylation.

scope: In an effort to identify the labeled protein(s), a biotin-streptavidin pulldown (Schematic in Fig. 5e) was performed with alkyne P29.
Upon incorporation of a biotin, P29-labeled proteins were enriched on streptavidin beads, subjected to an on-bead trypsin digestion and subsequent LC/LC–MS/MS analysis.
The solution was incubated overnight at 4 °C with 100 °L of streptavidin-agarose beads (ThermoFisher, washed 3X with DPBS to remove storage buffer).
